(Senior) Research Associate - Protein Science (gn)
Antibody Discovery & Development · Martinsried / Munich · Full-time

About us
iOmx Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company in the field of immuno-oncology, located in Martinsried/Munich, Germany. We are focused on the development of novel biomarker-supported cancer immunotherapies and are propagating an evolving pipeline of powerful multifunctional antibodies and T cell engagers. We are looking for highly motivated, self-driven and competent colleagues who share our vision and want to help turn it into reality. As part of our Protein Science team within the Antibody Discovery and Development Department, you will focus on the expression of recombinant proteins, antibodies and multispecific molecules in mammalian expression systems. You will advance the development of our transient expression platform, driving the discovery and development of innovative large-molecule biopharmaceuticals. Your responsibilities will include:

Plan and execute transient transfections in HEK and CHO - at various research scales
Develop and optimize our transient expression platforms: process, scale-up, yield, and quality
Run the molecular biology behind it: cloning and plasmid DNA prep at transfection scale
Contribute to construct design and feasibility assessment
Step in as dedicated backup for protein purification and downstream processing
Support analytics: characterization of recombinant proteins using state-of-the-art biochemical and biophysical methods (SDS-PAGE, LAL assay, HPLC)
Take responsibility for protein science lab equipment and infrastructure
Carefully evaluate, interpret, and document results in electronic lab journals and databases
Present data in internal meetings
You are the ideal candidate for this position if you bring the following:

You hold a vocational qualification as CTA, BTA, MTA or an equivalent university degree in a relevant field; at least 4 years of professional laboratory experience is preferred
You have in-depth experience in mammalian cell culture and transient transfection (HEK, CHO)
You have solid experience in cloning and molecular biology techniques; experience in construct design is a plus
You consider downstream processing and adjacent analytical methods as a welcome variety of your daily business
You pay attention to detail in experimental execution and documentation and have solid knowledge of relevant lab techniques and equipment, as well as standard laboratory and MS Office software
You are a well-organized, reliable team player with a hands-on mentality and strong communication skills
You work independently and efficiently, and adapt quickly to changing demands in a collaborative environment
You are proficient in English, both spoken and written
We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company with around 45 employees, driven by a shared purpose: to transform cancer treatment for patients. We work with flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes, in a welcoming and trusting environment where real progress comes from working together. What you can expect from us:

Work that matters: your work feeds directly into our pipeline of cancer immunotherapies, from multifunctional antibodies to T cell engagers on their way to the clinic
Real impact in a small team: your work is visible and you take on responsibility early
A culture of curiosity, integrity, and collaboration: we value diverse perspectives, open communication, and a hands-on mindset, in an environment where people grow together
On top of that: 30 days of vacation, flexible working hours, and support for a job bike or Deutschlandticket

Develop a method or development within EMBL’s areas of expertise, with potential for broader service application

Build professional networks through secondment and job shadowing at EMBL and ARISE2 partner organisations

You may develop projects in fields including:

Data and computational science: Bioinformatics, AI/ML, computational modelling, software engineering, data management, data science.

Imaging and optical engineering: Imaging and image analysis, optical engineering, detector development, microscopy, X-ray optics

Structural Biology and Mechanical Engineering: Automation, high-precision mechanics, microfluidics, robotics, X-ray crystallography

Biotechnology: (Bio)chemical engineering, chemistry or chemical biology, omics technologies.

A Ph.D. at the time of the call deadline (September 30, 2026). Researchers who have successfully defended their doctoral thesis but who have not yet been formally awarded the degree are eligible to apply.

The ability to work independently and in a collaborative settings
Excellent communication skills and fluency in English
Good organisational and time-management skills

You might also have

Experience in the improvement or development of methods, techniques or technology for service provision.

ARISE2 receives funding from HorizonEurope under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie action COFUND (grant agreement No 101178241). Snapshot of your Day

As a Data Analyst (f/m/d), you will support the Process Digitalization Team for Grid Technologies within Siemens Energy. Working closely with more than 30 factories across our global Manufacturing Network, you will contribute to the development and adoption of our secure, centrally governed, and AI-enabled Data Mesh.

Your focus will be on transforming scalable data into actionable insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and sustainable business growth. By analyzing complex datasets and translating business requirements into analytical solutions, you will drive cross-functional data and analytics initiatives that enhance competitiveness and support the future development of our products and processes. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Conducting in-depth analyses of manufacturing and operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement across the business area
* Supporting the definition, development, and continuous refinement of data structures and data products, with a focus on data quality, consistency, and usability
* Collaboration with data engineering and cloud architecture teams to ensure analytical requirements are reflected in data ingestion processes, data models, and platform capabilities
* Development and maintenance of dashboards, KPIs, reports, and lightweight analytical applications to increase transparency and support data-driven decision-making
* Continuous evaluation and optimization of analytical workflows, performance metrics, and reporting processes to enhance operational efficiency and business value creation
* Provision of actionable insights and analytical recommendations to support strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and the adoption of data-driven practices across the organization

What You Bring
* Academic degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable field, combined with professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data-driven process optimization
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including hands-on experience with modern data and analytics tools such as Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Alteryx, Python, and SQL
* Expertise in the development of dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting solutions, and data visualizations using leading business intelligence platforms such as Power BI and Tableau
* Solid understanding of cloud-based data ecosystems, preferably Snowflake and AWS, as well as modern data stack concepts including ELT processes and data modeling
* Ability to transform complex datasets into clear insights, actionable recommendations, and decision-relevant information for stakeholders across all organizational levels
* Business fluency in English, strong communication and stakeholder management skills, an international mindset and willingness to travel internationally

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Researcher (f/m/d) in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as of 01 November 2026:

Postdoc Researcher (m/f/d)

in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals** (m/f/d)**

(Full time / part time** **options available)

﻿

Location: Frankfurt am Main
Employment scope: Full-time; part time options are available
Type of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 years
Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity and climate change.

There is an exciting opportunity for a talented and motivated applicant to join the working group of Prof. Dr. Axel Janke. The applicant will be closely involved in gene flow, evolutionary, population or phylo-genetics to study speciation in mammals (bears, giraffe, kangaroos or allies) at the genomic level and in MSc and BSc teaching. Strong own and proven research interests including other vertebrate groups will be considered.

Your tasks

- Conduct genomic research on mammalian evolution and speciation, including evolutionary, population and phylogenomic analyses
- Investigate phylogenetic relationships, gene flow and genomic signatures of evolutionary and environmental processes using genomic and bioinformatic approaches
- Apply and further develop bioinformatic methods for the analysis of genomic data, including population genomics, genome assembly and species distribution modelling
- Organise and teach university courses and supervise BSc and MSc theses
- Independently prepare and publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and contribute to the acquisition of third-party funding

Your profile

- PhD degree in Biology, Genetics, Bioinformatics or a related field
- Strong interest and proven skills in evolutionary, population or phylogenomics.
- Knowledge of gene-flow analyses and/or drift processes is an advantage
- Experience in population genomics, genome assembly and script programming, including R
- Very good written and oral communication skills in English
- Interest in species distribution modelling, paternal inference, conservation genetics and epigenetics

- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations

The position is embedded in EU-MIC (European Coalition for Mental Health Medicines Innovation), a strategic initiative led by the European College of Neuropsychopharmacology (ECNP). EU-MIC aims to address the growing innovation gap in psychopharmacology between Europe and the United States and to examine the structural disparities between mental and somatic health in access to innovative medicines.

A major workstream of the project focuses on the quantification of the direct and indirect societal costs of mental disorders, including:

- healthcare and treatment costs
- sick leave, retirement and disability-related costs
- productivity losses
- presenteeism and absenteeism
- broader social and long-term economic consequences

The resulting evidence will contribute to scientific publications, European policy reports, and advocacy activities targeting regulators, HTA bodies, payers, policymakers, clinicians, patients, and carers.

The position is initially limited to two years, with the possibility of extending it to three years. There is also the opportunity to pursue a habilitation.

Your Role:

- Develop and implement a health-economic data analysis plan within EU-MIC
- Identify, collate, harmonise, and analyse national and international datasets (which, in part, will also be delivered by the supporting companies) and evidence sources

- Quantify presenteeism, productivity losses, and wider societal economic impacts
- Conduct systematic evidence reviews, evidence synthesis, and health-economic modelling
- Establish transparent data structures, metadata standards, and reproducible analytical workflows
- Prepare peer-reviewed publications, technical reports, policy briefs, and stakeholder presentations

- Analyse customer, mission and system requirements, including functional analyses, specification tree development and identification of required design adaptations
- Perform requirements engineering activities, including the decomposition and allocation of requirements to platform and subsystem level using DOORS and Polarion
- Monitor compliance with system requirements, coordinate with the Project Chief Engineer and Project Management, and initiate appropriate corrective actions where necessary.
- Support trade-off analyses and contribute to the definition of mission and system architectures.
- Contribute to the design and development of space systems, covering mission design, system architecture, subsystem definition and technical specifications.
- Manage and maintain system-level engineering budgets, including performance, mass, power and data budgets.
- Support interface management and budget management within the assigned engineering domain
- Contribute to the development and maintenance of the system Concept of Operations (CONOPS)
- Coordinate technical activities across subsystems, including impact assessments resulting from requirement changes, under the guidance of the Project Chief Engineer
- Support the technical coordination and management of subcontractors
- Provide direct engineering support and technical reporting to the Project Chief Engineer
- Support key system engineering reviews, including PDR, CDR and verification planning activities
- Assist in the implementation of approved design changes and the management of engineering deviations and non-conformances, including RFWs, RFDs and NCRs
- Contribute to system and subsystem verification activities, including the definition of test plans, test procedures and the evaluation of test results
- Prepare and maintain project documentation by coordinating technical inputs and documenting assigned work packages
- Support the preparation of technical proposals and bids for ADR and in-orbit servicing missions
Your Qualifications

- You hold a degree in Aerospace Engineering or a comparable technical field and have gained several years of experience in Systems Engineering, ideally within the space industry or another high-tech environment
- You are familiar with the full engineering lifecycle, from requirements analysis and specification development to defining system architectures and managing interfaces across complex projects
- You enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams and are confident communicating with a wide range of technical stakeholders
- A structured, solution-oriented approach, combined with creativity and a collaborative mindset, enables you to successfully tackle complex engineering challenges
- Experience in Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) and Rendezvous & Docking (RvD) would be a valuable asset. Fluency in English is essential, while German language skills are considered a plus
